identity_and_theme.subtitle: Sistem Monitoring Kepegawaian
identity_and_theme.mode: Light Dashboard with Dark Navy Structural Elements & Single-Viewport Landing Page
strict_visual_rules: ABSOLUTELY NO IMAGES or photos anywhere in the UI (no stock photos, no hero photos, no avatars from URLs, no building photos, no carousels, no decorative banners).
No logo on the landing page.
Landing page MUST fit strictly within ONE single viewport height (100vh / h-screen) without scrolling.
Primary color palette strictly adhered to: Navy #0B1F3A, Dark Navy #071426, Gold #C9A227, Soft Gold #D8B95A, Silver #A7ADB5, Light Silver #E5E7EB, White #FFFFFF, Background #F8FAFC.
Use typography, layout, borders, crisp shadows, subtle geometric badges, and Lucide React icons for all visual hierarchy.

hierarchy.caption: text-xs text-slate-500

landing_page.footer: border-t border-slate-800 pt-4 flex justify-between items-center text-xs text-slate-400

accessibility_and_testing.test_id_rules: All interactive buttons, text inputs, selects, tab triggers, modal triggers, table rows, and status badges MUST feature a readable kebab-case data-testid attribute.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standard: All text over Navy or Gold must meet minimum WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 ratio).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly avoid any images, image tags, Unsplash placeholders, external image URLs, or image background CSS rule.
Ensure public landing page fits in ONE viewport (100vh) without scrollbars.
Ensure navigation drawer works cleanly on mobile responsive break-points.
Add data-testid attributes to all key inputs, actions, tabs, status badges, and data cells.
Use standard Lucide icons and pure CSS color/shadow treatments for visual depth.
